content.query: For each SIC division, count how many stocks are in the pack, and how many of those are among the 500 most liquid stocks. Sort by total stocks descending.
content.answer: This query counts the number of stocks in each SIC division (sector) and how many of those stocks rank among the top 500 most liquid by liquidity_rank. It groups records from the assets table by sector, computes total stocks and the subset with liquidity_rank ≤ 500, then orders the results by total stocks descending.
content.sql: SELECT a.sector, COUNT(*) AS total_stocks, SUM(CASE WHEN a.liquidity_rank <= 500 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS top_500_stocks FROM us_equities.main.assets a GROUP BY a.sector ORDER BY total_stocks DESC;

content.query: Among Manufacturing stocks that are in the 500 most liquid, which five SIC industries (4-digit SIC codes) have the most stocks? Show the industry description and count.
content.answer: This query counts how many manufacturing stocks belong to each 4-digit SIC industry among the 500 most liquid stocks (as indicated by liquidity_rank). It uses the assets table to filter by sector and liquidity rank, groups by the industry description, and returns the five industries with the highest stock counts.
content.sql: SELECT a.industry, COUNT(DISTINCT a.asset_id) AS stock_count FROM us_equities.main.assets AS a WHERE a.sector = 'Manufacturing' AND a.liquidity_rank <= 500 GROUP BY a.industry ORDER BY stock_count DESC LIMIT 5;
